assertions.name: A1_plancherel_is_not_a_markov_trace
assertions.source: Markov ratio is z on both; Plancherel gives h/2 and -2q^3/(q^6+2q^4-2q^2-1)

assertions.name: A2_plancherel_does_not_annihilate_antisymmetriser
assertions.source: W_alt = q^2/D != 0 while y_alt = 0; Markov Gram rank 5/6, det -1.60e-16

assertions.name: A3_plancherel_not_multiplicative_on_blocks
assertions.source: 36/36 pairs fail, worst rel err 1.089e+01, sign flip on s0xs0 rules out a normalisation fix

assertions.name: A4_both_costs_give_zero
assertions.source: multiplicative gap max 2.22e-16 at full 6^A (1296 vars at 4He); additive zero already shown

assertions.name: A6_critical_not_geometric
assertions.source: 86/300 random costs bind; gap/eps constant over 6 decades in 5/24 directions

description: Settles which functional the substrate extremises. Three independent properties the corpus already demands each reject the q-Plancherel weighting and select the convention-D Markov trace: Plancherel is not a Markov trace (tr(x.T_n)/tr(x) is h/2 on gamma but -2q^3/(q^6+2q^4-2q^2-1) on s0, not constant); it does not annihilate the q-antisymmetriser (W_alt = q^2/D != 0 against y_alt = 0), so its Gram is nonsingular and its cone is not the corpus's; and it is not multiplicative on disjoint strand blocks at H_6 (36/36 pairs fail, worst rel err 10.9, with a sign flip on s0xs0 ruling out a normalisation fix), which is the property that gives t^(A) = t^(x)A. So the metallic ladder is a property of a functional the substrate cannot use. The additive/multiplicative question is a non-issue: both give exactly zero binding at q_0, the multiplicative verified at full 6^A (1296 vars at 4He), because the dual optimum is rank one and shared by both nucleons (y* = 0.54312042 e_2), making phi(v) = lam (Gv)_2 exactly linear and hence exactly additive. The zero is critical rather than geometric: 86 of 300 random nonnegative costs open a positive gap, and where a gap opens it grows exactly linearly in the perturbation (gap/eps constant over six decades), so the Markov cost lies on the boundary of the no-gap region.

data.verdict: Markov trace, on three independent grounds

caveats: RETIRING THE METALLIC LADDER IS A RE-SCOPING, NOT A REFUTATION. The silver coincidence T(sigma) = (h/2) T(gamma) at every n, and the Lean silver_lp_coincidence it generalises, remain true theorems about the Plancherel functional. What is established here is that the substrate's own dynamics cannot be posed over that functional, so the ladder is not available as a physical mechanism. If a future construction finds a legitimate role for the Plancherel weighting, the metallic results come back with it.

CORRECTION AGAINST AN EARLIER DRAFT OF THIS PROBE. A first pass detected gap-opening with abs(gap) > 1e-9 and reported a knife-edge radius of 3e-8; those were NEGATIVE gaps, which are structurally impossible since aggregation is a relaxation — i.e. solver noise, not signal. All measurements here are sign-aware with a relative threshold, zero spurious negatives are observed, and the boundary claim rests on the linear scaling of the gap over six decades rather than on any radius.

The Markov multiplicativity leg is asserted from h3a_frobenius_gram_offdiagonal_probe (max rel err 1.1e-8 over the same 36 pairs), not re-run here; only the Plancherel side is recomputed. The two use the same build_seminormal_matrices routine and the same basis pairs, so the comparison is like-for-like.
